title: Eight-year-old Haitian boy returns home after release from ICE custody
summary_full: Child reunited with family after he was detained by immigration agents in San Diego and transferred to TexasAn eight-year-old Haitian boy who was put into restraints and detained by immigration agents in San Diego on 4 November and transferred to a facility in Texas has been reunited with his family in California.Representative Juan Vargas shared a photograph of the boy and his family in a social media post on Monda, writing: “11 days ago, an 8-year-old in San Diego was taken into federal custody during an immigration check-in. He was separated from his loved ones and held in a facility in Texas. Today, he’s finally home.” Continue reading...
